venues.name: D&C DC
venues.notes_summary: **DC — Tuesday 2/24.** Slow start with a few guests before dinner; push ~9pm filled the room to about three quarters with a nice mix of larger groups. Bar top cleared by 9:45 so dropped to one bartender with a barback; last call 11:30, building clear by 12:10am. Decent Tuesday, just shy of daily target. Comps include a server spill. Kitchen: 12.75% of sales; balanced mix of items, potatoes the most popular; smooth service. MOD: Josh.

venues.name: D&C EV
venues.notes_summary: **EV — Tuesday 2/24.** Slow Tuesday, coming back from the blizzard closure the day before. Bigger push at the front end, bar and restaurant semi-full until ~10pm; moved a large party to T2-4 for comfort. Saw Haleigh and friends, industry folks FO Bowen, and a solo chef from Seattle. Comps $74.68 (industry and employees). Door: weather dropped and stayed low; bar full ~8pm, push at 6pm with an 8 top; most 6pm reservations left before 8pm; a stand-up comic came in; died down at 10pm with few people walking around. No no-shows. Kitchen: Day 3 training for Arriel. (Report posted ~4:37pm the next day after a request in channel.)
